source: Game Concept/narrative/FINAL_SCRIPT.md, SC06 and its encounter notes. Lines marked "system": true are gameplay feedback, hints or placeholder prompts that are not in the script; review them before release.

arrive.text: At a dry culvert, a woman calls to Tavo in Mera's voice. She wears Mera's scarf, but her clothes are wet.

figure_plead.text: Water pools at her feet in a dry culvert. Something in it moves out of time.

reflection.caption: [reflection speaks out of time]
reflection.text: In the water at her feet, the figure's reflection mouths different words.

question.speaker: FIGURE
question.text: Say you know me. Just say it.

question.speaker: NALI
question.text: Ask her something she would refuse to give you.

question.speaker: TAVO
question.text: Tell me what happened when I was seven.
The figure repeats the question with precisely his intonation. It cannot answer. Its outline collapses into a rope of water and silt.
When the ring appears, get clear of it. When the copper hook is exposed, strike it.

after.speaker: NALI
after.text: I knew it was wrong. I didn't know what it would do.

after.speaker: NALI
after.text: Something asking you to let it be her.

inspect_hook.speaker: TAVO
inspect_hook.text: An official mark. Someone built a place for this thing to attach.

defeat.text: The water throws Tavo back up the bank. He gets his footing and tries again.

nali_before.speaker: NALI
nali_before.text: Look before you go to her.

nali_after.speaker: NALI
nali_after.text: Reed Gate. Before anything else learns your voice.

exit_locked.text: Not with that thing at the crossing.
